name: kryptos-pii
description: Blocks prompts carrying personal information before the model receives them, and gives Claude tools to mask PII in everything else.

mode.title: Where masking runs
mode.description: local keeps the text on this machine and needs no API key. hosted sends it to Kryptos, where the call is metered and audited.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: The interpreter that has kryptos-pii-local (or kryptos-pii-client) and mcp installed. Use a virtualenv's python if you installed there.

api_key.title: Kryptos API key
api_key.description: Only used in hosted mode. Create one in the Kryptos dashboard under API keys; it needs the pii:* scopes.

base_url.title: Kryptos URL
base_url.description: Only used in hosted mode. Change this if you run your own Kryptos deployment.
